description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class 'KpiAPITest' for testing the 'KpiAPI' class in the OrangeHRM Performance API module. It includes test methods for create, update, get all, get one, and delete operations on KPIs, utilizing data providers and mock services.

classes.name: KpiAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing KPI API endpoints in the OrangeHRM performance module.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of KPIs via KPI API using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all KPIs via KPI API.
